meta.bio: Kevin Luis Linuhung, known online as Ventustium, is a system infrastructure and DevOps enthusiast from Indonesia. He works with Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, MikroTik, Ruijie and Cloudflare, writes PHP with PostgreSQL and MySQL, and translates Japanese web novels.
